name: Ancient North Arabian
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: epigraphic corpus in vowelless scripts (Macdonald); stress/accent unrecoverable and undescribed

sources.citation: Al-Jallad, Ahmad. 2015. An Outline of the Grammar of the Safaitic Inscriptions (Studies in Semitic Languages and Linguistics 80). Leiden: Brill. doi:10.1163/9789004289826
sources.note: No stress section (ch. 3 = 3.1 Consonants p. 41, 3.2 Vowels p. 46, 3.4 Sound Changes p. 48). Stress appears only incidentally: p. 50 a>0/#CvC_# 'perhaps exclusively in items without lexical stress (such as prepositions and pronouns)'; p. 51 n-assimilation 'in stressed word-internal environments'; p. 89 relative *man 'probably stressed' vs proclitic *min; p. 120 two reconstructed Proto-Arabic 'stress-based sound changes'. Never states where stress falls.
